title: SRS Field Definition
description: An atomic, reusable field definition. Fields are the shared vocabulary of SRS — defined once, referenced across many Types.
$comment: RFC-033 frozen-seed fixed point: this hand-authored schema is the bootstrap base case, loaded as committed and never re-derived at runtime (a schema that defines Field cannot be parsed without the Field schema). Its record-level source is the com.semanticops.srs/metamodel package (the `field` Type + FieldType/ExactTypeRef/AiGuidance/AiGuidanceExample/Lineage/Provenance value-object Types); the #259 emitter regenerates this file from those records, and docs/schema/2.0/metamodel-fidelity.md declares which features round-trip authoritatively vs are approximated.

id.description: Globally unique, stable identifier for this Field.

namespace.description: Logical grouping. 'core' is reserved for SRS standard definitions.

name.description: Machine-readable name within the namespace; snake_case.

instructions.description: Fuller guidance for a human completing this field.

fieldType.description: RFC-032 — the decomposed value type: datatype × cardinality × value-domain × format × constraints. Replaces the pre-RFC-032 closed scalar `valueType` enum and its companion properties (`contentFormat`, `allowedValues`, `vocabularyRef`, `validationRules`).

defaultValue.description: Default value applied when no value is supplied. Must conform to this Field's fieldType (a value-of-self dependent — RFC-032 Change C).

editorHint.description: Presentation only (not part of the type model — RFC-032). Suggested UI control; implementations and Views may override. Consolidated by the rendering follow-up #262.

FieldType.description: RFC-032 Change A — orthogonal type facets. Conditional requirements (R2/R3/R9/R10) are expressed in the allOf branches below; the full semantic conformance check (R1–R11) is scripts/lib/rfc-032-fieldtype.mjs::validateFieldType.

datatype.description: The base datatype. `ref` = range is another Type (Change B); `dependent` = value-of-a-sibling-type (Change C); `map` = open string-keyed collection (Change D).

cardinality.description: Whether the field holds one value or an ordered list. Default: single. The sole cardinality mechanism (R4) — former `multiselect` and standalone `repeatable` are subsumed here.

valueDomain.description: datatype == string only (R3). Default: open. When closed, exactly one of allowedValues or vocabularyRef is present.

allowedValues.description: Inline, field-fixed closed vocabulary (valueDomain == closed). Mutually exclusive with vocabularyRef.

vocabularyRef.description: A CONFIGURABLE data range: an RFC-006 Reference (namespace/name@version) to a mode:closed Vocabulary whose Terms are managed in package config. Mutually exclusive with allowedValues. Projects to a pure enum of the Vocabulary's effective Term keys at schema-generation time (Change G).

format.description: datatype == string only. Semantic string format (JSON-Schema-aligned); date/date-time are first-class datatypes, not formats.

constraints.description: Datatype-appropriate value constraints (R10). Carries the former ValidationRule facets (Change F).

pattern.description: datatype == string; an ECMA-262 regular expression.

rangeType.description: datatype == ref only, REQUIRED (R2). The Type this field's range is (Change B).

mode.description: datatype == ref only. inline = nested object(s) conforming to rangeType; reference = target instance id(s). Default: inline. Fixed per Field (R8).

dependsOn.description: datatype == dependent only, REQUIRED (R6). "self" (the field's own fieldType) or a sibling field name whose type the value conforms to (Change C).

valueRange.description: datatype == map only, REQUIRED (R9). The scalar value datatype, or "open" for a true extension bag (Change D). Composite value ranges are out of scope.

ExactTypeRef.description: RFC-009 I-78. A version-exact reference to a Type in the Package. Both typeId and typeVersion are required. Distinct from the pre-RFC-009 spec-level TypeRef (Protocol) where typeVersion was optional.

typeVersion.description: Version of the Type this ref targets (required — version-exact anchor validated against the Package).

extraction.description: LLM instruction for how to extract or populate.

negativeGuidance.description: What the LLM must NOT include or do.
